answer: One defence is Signed sailing race handicap certificate with yacht club attestation: a handicap the yacht club recalculated across two racing seasons, and the nadir of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The pearl grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big. The bridge is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
